description: Fetch your grade breakdown for a specific course or all enrolled courses in D2L Brightspace. Shows grade items (grade columns) with points, percentages, and comments. Pass course with a name or code when you know it, or courseId when you have the ID. Use this when the user asks about grades, grade items, grade item, scores, marks, GPA, academic performance, or how they're doing in a class in Brightspace or D2L. Example: "What's my current grade in Calculus?"

course.description: Course name or code to get grades for, for example "CS 101". Use this instead of courseId when you know the name.

courseId.description: Course ID to get grades for. If omitted, returns grades for all enrolled courses.

name: get_my_grades
title: Get My Grades
